title.value: Master of Science in Tropical Biodiversity and Ecosystems (Mundus tropicalis c/o TROPIMUNDO)
title.evidence_quote: Master of Science in Tropical Biodiversity and Ecosystems (Mundus tropicalis c/o TROPIMUNDO), an ICP Connect Scholarship by VLIRUOS

qualifications: Nationality of, and residence in, a VLIR-UOS eligible country
Not older than 35 on 1 January of the intake year (initial master programmes)
Only one ICP Connect scholarship application per year; no other scholarship for the same or another programme at the same time
No previous Belgian government study scholarship and no enrolment at a Belgian higher education institution before 1 January of the intake year
description_short: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect full scholarship for the Mundus tropicalis master in tropical biodiversity and ecosystems, running September 2027 to September 2029. Scholarships cover tuition, travel, insurance and living expenses. Applications opened 3 October 2026 and close 30 November 2026.

compensation.value: Full scholarship covering tuition fees, travel, insurance and living expenses (board and lodging)
compensation.evidence_quote: Scholarships cover tuition fees, travel, insurance and living expenses (board and lodging)
